NeuralNg Tag rules

- Import only from `@neural-ng/core/tag`.
- Import NeuralTag. TagComponent is a deprecated compatibility alias.
- Use Tag for classification or textual status; use Badge for contextual counts.
- Prefer `value` for plain text and projection for custom Angular markup.
- Severities: `primary`, `secondary`, `neutral`, `info`, `success`, `warning`, `error`.
- Sizes: `small`, `medium`, `large`; `rounded` defaults to true.
- `iconClass` prepends an icon. Decorative icons need no accessible label.
- `removable` creates a native button and emits `removed`.
- `removed` carries `{ value, originalEvent }`; update the owning collection.
- Do not expect Tag to remove itself after emitting.
- Override the generated remove name with `removeLabel` when context requires it.
- `disabled` prevents removal and exposes `aria-disabled`.
- `unstyled` removes visual classes, not structural hooks.
- Typed slots: `root`, `icon`, `label`, `content`, `removeButton`, `removeIcon`.
